name: Favourite toggle
description: A heart that fills when tapped.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/favourite-toggle", name: "Favourite toggle", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "A heart that fills when tapped.",
  states: [BoolState(name: "liked", default: false)],
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Box(shape: BoxShape.circle, width: 44, height: 44, alignment: Anchor.center, background: state.liked ? Color.danger : Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1, color: state.liked ? Color.danger : Color.border), onTap: Toggle(state: "liked"), ariaLabel: "Favourite", child: Icon(name: Icons.heart, color: state.liked ? Color.primaryInk : Color.textMuted))
  )],
)
